map.分类打包清单，多种模板，进度统计，本地保存: Categorized packing lists, multiple templates, progress tracking, saved locally
map.选择一个旅行类型模板快速生成清单: Choose a trip type template to generate a list quickly
map.列出清单 → 全部摊开 → 去掉一半 → 打包出发: Lay out the list → spread everything out → remove half → pack and go
map.卷衣法比折叠法更省空间，减少褶皱: Rolling clothes saves more space than folding and reduces creases
map.使用收纳袋分类存放衣物，方便查找: Use packing cubes to group clothing by category so it is easy to find
map.护照、钱包、电子产品等随身携带，不要托运: Keep passports, wallets and electronics in your carry-on rather than checked luggage
map.随身携带液体单瓶不超过100ml，总量不超过1L: Carry-on liquids are limited to 100ml per container and 1L in total
map.随身放一套换洗衣物，防止托运行李延误: Carry a change of clothes with you in case checked luggage is delayed
map.充电宝必须随身携带，不能托运，额定能量不超过100Wh: Power banks must be carried in the cabin, not checked, with rated energy no more than 100Wh
map.感冒药、肠胃药、创可贴、晕车药、过敏药: Cold medicine, stomach medicine, adhesive bandages, motion sickness pills and allergy medicine
map.衣物 10、洗漱 8、电子 6，共 24 项；勾选 16 项，进度 16÷24×: Clothing 10, toiletries 8, electronics 6 for 24 items in total; 16 checked off gives progress of 16÷24×100 ≈ 66.7%, with 8 items left.
map.每类可加物品（Enter 提交），实时重算总数与完成率，: You can add items to any category (press Enter to submit); the total and completion rate recalculate live,
map.随勾选变宽。: widens as you check items off.
map.清单存浏览器本地（localStorage），刷新不丢；可清历史重置。: The list is stored locally in the browser (localStorage) and survives a refresh; history can be cleared to reset.
map.内置商务/亲子/户外等模板，一键载入再增删。: Business, family and outdoor templates are built in; load one in a click and then add or remove items.
map.旅行打包清单。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用。: Travel Packing List. A travel tool that is essential for trips and works offline.
